title: Patagonia Telephoto Landscape: Layered White Adjustments for Depth and Light
summary: This video tutorial demonstrates a layered post-processing workflow on telephoto landscape imagery, emphasizing haze management, depth separation, and directional light. The presenter repeatedly applies and blends Whites adjustments to lift a hazy foreground and bring warmth, then isolates the background using masking and painting to push distant structures further away. The workflow includes foreground emphasis (bonsai-like tree subject), water-layer masking for depth, sky enhancement with strong highlights, and careful dodge/burn to sculpt light and shadows. Final touches cover foreground simplification with blur to reduce texture, and crop considerations to sharpen composition. Throughout, the emphasis is on non-destructive multi-pass edits, masking, and targeted local adjustments to guide the viewer’s eye through the scene along the light source.
topics: Whites adjustment (tonal lift) for hazy scenes
Masking and painting to isolate background/foreground
Hard-edge brush usage for targeted edits
Color grading and selective detail control

sections.title: Initial whites adjustment pass and warmth for hazy telephoto shot
sections.description: Begin with a large Whites adjustment to lift the hazy mountain layers, then apply a second pass to increase contrast and warmth; plan to blend the two renders and crop to frame.

sections.title: Background separation planning in layered telephoto
sections.description: Discusses separating the background area to push it further away and capitalize on a strong composition; notes multiple candidate shots from that day.

sections.title: Foreground emphasis and light shaping (bonsai, water, vignette)
sections.description: Describes brightening the foreground feature (bonsai-like tree) and using a water layer to create separation; applies a hard-edge brush to paint and then creates a subtle edge vignette.

sections.title: Sky processing and directional light emphasis
sections.description: Notes aggressive sky edits via repeated Whites adjustments; discusses maintaining directional light and considers crop choice to optimize composition.

sections.title: Dodge & burn to reveal sun-lit areas and deepen background
sections.description: Demonstrates targeted dodging to brighten shadowed regions and imply sunlight behind trees; uses careful brushwork to control depth and light spill.

sections.title: Foreground simplification with blur and final notes
sections.description: Illustrates using blur to reduce foreground texture and smooth the middle ground; acknowledges that some shots could benefit from further processing later.
